title: vLastPlayedServer
description: Adds a clean “Last Played Servers” list to the multiplayer screen, with search, favorites, tags, notes, and quick actions like join, copy IP, and add to the main server list.
body:
# vLastPlayedServer

[![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef01ad6b39a79dd292c4984e6b8a8c27b08d08c9.png)](https://discord.gg/5AWcWHBCPt)


VLastServerPlayed adds a clean **Last Played Servers** menu to Minecraft’s multiplayer screen, making it easier to keep track of servers you have recently joined.

The mod automatically remembers multiplayer servers after you connect to them and gives you a dedicated history screen where you can search, organize, and quickly access them again.

## Features

- Automatically saves servers you recently joined
- Adds a **Last Played** button to the multiplayer screen
- Search saved servers by name, IP, tag, or note
- Pin favorite servers to keep them at the top
- Add custom tags for easier organization
- Add personal notes to saved servers
- Copy server IPs to your clipboard
- Join saved servers directly from the history screen
- Add saved servers back to the main Minecraft server list
- Shows whether a saved server is already added to your main server list
- Lightweight custom list UI without pinging every saved server on open

## Why Use It?

Minecraft’s default multiplayer screen only shows servers you manually added. If you join servers through direct connect, temporary invites, or testing environments, they can be easy to lose.

VLastServerPlayed keeps a simple history of those servers so you can find them again later without searching through chats, launchers, screenshots, or old messages.

## Notes

This is a client-side mod. It does not need to be installed on servers.
